summary: Fortress Private Lending Fund filed an 8-K covering unregistered sales of its Class I common shares in May 2026 for ~$10.4M aggregate consideration. Shares were sold at NAV per share ($24.16) to accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. The filing also declares a routine monthly distribution ($0.1812 per share) and provides a portfolio update. This is a periodic capital raise and dividend announcement, not a transformative special situation. The SEC filing describes a standard BDC continuous offering and monthly distribution, without any acquisition, divestiture, or other major corporate event. No deal terms apply.
